criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management (Physical)
categories.definition: Inquiries about ordering, receiving, activating, replacing, linking, or general functionality of physical cards.

categories.name: Lost, Stolen, or Damaged Card
categories.definition: Queries related to reporting, cancelling, freezing, reactivating, or issues with ATMs retaining physical cards.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Questions about unlocking, changing, finding, or issues related to card PINs.

categories.name: Virtual Card Management
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining, using, security, or issues specific to virtual or disposable cards.

categories.name: Top-up Issues & Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions about fees, limits, auto-top-up, failed, pending, or general functionality issues related to adding funds to an account.

categories.name: Transaction Status & Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries about pending, missing, failed, or declined transactions (transfers, deposits, withdrawals, payments), duplicate charges, or unrecognized transactions.

categories.name: Refunds, Disputes & Cancellations
categories.definition: Requests to dispute charges, process refunds, or cancel transactions or payments.

categories.name: Fees & Charges Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about specific fees, unexpected charges, or general fee structures, excluding currency exchange rates.

categories.name: Account Information & Management
categories.definition: Inquiries about opening or closing accounts, updating personal details, or general account settings.

categories.name: Identity Verification & KYC
categories.definition: Questions about the process, requirements, or reasons for identity verification or source of funds checks.

categories.name: Currency Exchange & Rates
categories.definition: Inquiries about exchange rates, converting currencies, supported currencies, or related processes.

categories.name: Transfer Information & How-to
categories.definition: Questions about how to make transfers, transfer policies, limits, or expected transfer times.

categories.name: Geographic & Service Availability
categories.definition: Inquiries about where cards can be used, countries of operation, delivery locations, or ATM compatibility.

categories.name: App & Technical Support
categories.definition: Issues related to app access, contactless payments, or other technical functionalities within the banking application.
